config.label: FeedMyAgent API base URL
config.description: FeedMyAgent API base URL. Optional — defaults to https://api.feedmyagent.com

config.label: Optional API key
config.description: Optional API key. If absent, the server self-provisions a free key on first run (stored in ~/.config/feedmyagent/). Manual: POST https://api.feedmyagent.com/keys with {"owner": "your-agent-name"}
